name: alert
description: Classes that style a <div> as a colored message with an optional icon, title, and close icon. CSS only: no role, no dismiss, and the flash animation leaves the element on the page.

props.variant: Add alert--warning, alert--danger, alert--alert, alert--info, or alert--notice by hand. With none, the alert has no colors.
props.tone: Add alert--muted or alert--filled by hand. The story helper also adds alert--outlined, which alert.css does not style.
props.flash: Add alert--flash by hand. The element stays in the page after it slides out.

props.name: Material Symbols: write the name as the text and add the icon classes. alert__icon sets the private icon variables for a large, bold icon.

props.label: None. Add aria-label by hand.
props.onClick: None. Remove the alert with your own JS.

modifiers.alert--muted: A darker background and no border. Only works with a variant
modifiers.alert--filled: The strongest background and no border. Only works with a variant
modifiers.alert--flash: Fixed at the top right, with a 5s slide in and out animation

customPropertiesNote: No custom properties. Every value comes straight from a global token. Each variant and tone sets background-color, box-shadow, color, and the title color directly, so a new variant copies all three tones' rules. The close button reuses alert__icon and Optics button classes.
